description: Solar ingress instants (sankranti) - when the Sun enters each sidereal rashi. Drives the Nepali solar month boundaries and therefore every BS date.

source.notes: UNPOPULATED. REQUIRED in source.convention. State: which ayanamsha; whether the printed instant is the true ingress or rounded; and the day-assignment rule (e.g. 'sankranti before midnight belongs to that day' vs a sunrise-based rule). This rule IS the cultural logic under test — without it a disagreement cannot be adjudicated. Do not fill from this engine's own output — the loader rejects a self-referential authority.

tolerance.rationale: Published patro sankranti times are printed to the minute; 120 s accepts a printed-minute difference plus the ayanamsha-formula spread, which shifts an ingress instant more than it shifts a longitude.
